feature_name: Preserve thought_signature in GenAI validation retries
description: Modify the GENAI_TOOLS validation retry mechanism to preserve response metadata (particularly thought_signature) when validation fails and the system needs to re-ask the model. Instead of discarding metadata, replay the original model content and append tool function responses containing validation errors. This ensures metadata like thought_signature persists across retry attempts.
functional_requirements: Update the reask_genai_tools function to preserve thought_signature and other metadata when validation fails
Implement logic that replays the original model content and appends tool function responses containing validation error details
Handle edge cases where function calls are absent or not the first part of the response
Add unit tests covering the GENAI reask path with thought_signature preservation
Add end-to-end validation retry tests for the GENAI_TOOLS mode (LLM-gated)
Clean up any unused imports in related validation and audit modules
